description: This Swift source file defines the `CLIInstallPrompter` class responsible for managing prompts related to installing the OpenClaw CLI tool within the application. The class handles user interactions, prompts, and installation flow control, including opening settings and checking installation status.

classes.name: CLIInstallPrompter
classes.description: Manages prompts and installation flow for the OpenClaw CLI tool, including user prompts, installation status, and opening settings.

classes.name: StatusBox
classes.description: An actor class used internally for managing temporary status messages during CLI installation.

methods.name: checkAndPromptIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks conditions and prompts the user to install the CLI if needed.

methods.name: shouldPrompt
methods.description: Determines if the user should be prompted to install the CLI based on various application states.

methods.name: installCLI
methods.description: Handles the asynchronous installation of the CLI and updates the user interface upon completion.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Opens the application settings window and navigates to the specified tab.

methods.name: appVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the application version string from the bundle info dictionary.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value in the StatusBox actor, used during CLI installation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Gets the current value from the StatusBox actor.
